trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the finish line, not a task: it is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. The shape of the run is kind — one playthrough is enough, the difficulty is rated 4 out of 10, and the whole hunt is estimated at roughly 200 hours, most of it the 100% checklist rather than the story.

steps.t: Finish the story across the five chapters. Chapter trophies pop late — at the start of the NEXT chapter — so a quiet chapter ending is normal, not a bug.
After the story, work the 100% checklist: it only asks for about 60% of everything the game tracks, and nothing on it can be missed.
Finish with the Strangers & Freaks finales and one-off clean-up; when the 54th trophy lands, this one follows immediately.

tips: Keep a save at the start and end of every chapter — there is no mission replay.
Cheats disable trophies AND saving while active; never touch them on your main save.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening story trophy. Gone Fishing is the first main mission of Chapter 1, and this pops as it wraps up — there is no optional objective, collectible or choice attached to it.

steps.t: Start the story and play Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops on completion and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.popsNote: Late pop: unlocks only after What's in the Bag?, the first main mission of Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Do not panic when Chapter 1 ends and nothing pops: this trophy is a late popper. It is only awarded once you have also completed the first main mission of Chapter 2, so it lands a mission later than its own description suggests.

steps.t: Play Chapter 1 to the end — its last main mission is Discharge Time, after the Tourist Trap run locks you into Chapter 2.
Start Chapter 2 and complete What's in the Bag?; Paradise Lost pops then.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.popsNote: Late pop: unlocks after Welcome to Vice City, the first main mission of Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's trophy follows the same late-pop pattern: it arrives one mission into Chapter 3. Chapter 2 itself ends with Checking Out, the move to Vice City, which only starts once every other Chapter 2 main mission is done and you hold at least $15,000.

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 2 main mission and have at least $15,000 ready — Checking Out demands both before it starts.
Complete Checking Out to close Chapter 2, then play Welcome to Vice City in Chapter 3; the trophy pops after it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.popsNote: Late pop: unlocks after Ocean Beach AND Another Life, the first TWO main missions of Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: The latest of the late pops: finishing Chapter 3 is not enough on its own. This trophy waits until you have completed the first two main missions of Chapter 4, so expect it well after The Cartel Heist is behind you.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3, which ends with The Cartel Heist itself.
In Chapter 4, complete Ocean Beach and then Another Life; Vice City, Baby! pops after the second of them.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 closes with Starting From Zero, and this trophy is placed right after it. Chapter 4 is the longest stretch of the story, carrying both the VCIA Takedown chain and the run-up to the finale, so this one lands deep into the game.

steps.t: Work through Chapter 4's main missions, including the long VCIA Takedown chain, Headliners and Tie Up Loose Ends.
Complete Starting From Zero, the final main mission of Chapter 4; the trophy pops after it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.popsNote: Placement disputed between our sources — see the dispute panel.
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story's final mission. Every source agrees the trophy itself is unmissable — but they disagree about where the 'final mission' actually sits, and we show that disagreement openly below rather than papering over it.

steps.t: Play the story to its end; every story trophy before this one is unmissable, so a single playthrough is enough.
Keep one untouched save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay if anything goes wrong at the end.

disputes.a: The PowerPyx roadmap places this trophy's pop right after Starting From Zero, the last main mission of Chapter 4.
disputes.b: The PowerPyx full walkthrough lists a complete Chapter 5 after Starting From Zero — ten more missions ending with The End of the Road.

trophies.unconfirmed: Which structure is correct was unresolved in every source we read. Either way the trophy is unmissable; only its position on the road is in question.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story beat inside Chapter 2: Trust is tied to the main mission Breakfast Run (Check on Jason) and pops while it plays out. Nothing optional is attached — if you are following the story, you already have it.

steps.t: Reach Chapter 2 and play the main mission Breakfast Run.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops during it and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is built around one big job: the robbery of the Sinfrontera National Bank. A chain of preparation missions leads into it, and Break the Bank pops during the heist itself.

steps.t: Work through the Cartel Heist preparation chain in Chapter 3: scope out the bank, steal the practice safe, run the planning and prepping steps as they unlock.
Start The Cartel Heist when Raul gets in touch and play it through; the trophy pops during the heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 story trophy tied to Child's Play, the mission where Rafa is rescued from kidnappers. The missions around Andrés and Rafa earlier in the chapter lead straight into it.

steps.t: In Chapter 4, follow the missions around Andrés and Rafa — Adventures in Babysitting and Rafa's Kidnapping set this up.
Complete Child's Play, the rescue itself; the trophy pops during the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: DWNFALL belongs to Headliners, the Chapter 4 main mission built around a launch party, sitting late in the chapter's VCIA Takedown stretch. It is a straight story pop with no side conditions.

steps.t: Progress Chapter 4's VCIA Takedown chain until Headliners (Help With The Launch Party) unlocks.
Complete Headliners; the trophy pops during the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Hi-Jacked is the payoff of Chapter 4's longest chain: the VCIA Takedown, an airport heist assembled piece by piece across a dozen missions for Raul, Nate and Kordell's crew before the job itself can start.

steps.t: Work the whole VCIA Takedown chain in Chapter 4 — the workouts, surveillance, deliveries and planning missions marked with the chain's name.
Start VCIA Takedown, the airport heist, once the plans are in place; the trophy pops during it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: The Chapter 5 story trophy, tied to Operation Savage Glory, the fifth mission of the final chapter. By the time you reach it, the endgame is already moving — keep that pre-finale save discipline from the roadmap.

steps.t: Reach Chapter 5 and play through Bird in the Hand, Taking Liberties, Doggie Bag (Meet Vinny) and VC Baby.
Complete Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops during the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The real platinum gate, and the roadmap's pick for the hardest trophy on the list. The 100% checklist only becomes visible after the story, at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but everything you did during the story already counts, nothing on the list can be missed, and it only demands about 60% of everything the game actually tracks.

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist unlocks afterwards and retroactively counts all your earlier progress.
Clear the five all-or-nothing categories in full: Robberies, Underwater Discoveries (33/33), Shooting Ranges (42/42 gold medals), Drone Races (42/42) and Bret's Quests (15/15 target decks).
Hit the partial targets: 100 optional tasks, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 39/39 gang operations, 15 of 18 meditations.
Respect the unlock gates: Bank Jobs and Payday Loans open after Chapter 3's Credit Check, and Large Bank Vaults only after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…

tips: Each meditation counts as an optional task too, and counts double when done with both characters.
Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app as you meet it — 200 scans is the longest pole if you leave it late.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 stunts from a pool of 397, mixed freely across four families — you never need to touch the families you dislike. One honest warning: the published location lists are still incomplete (the stunt-jump guide had only 24 of 130 jumps listed when we read it), so the in-game map tracking matters more here than in most guides.

steps.t: Mix the four stunt families freely: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps make 397 in total — any 250 of them count.
A stunt is complete the first time you perform it; the extra challenge shown on its map icon is NOT required.
Track progress per region at Progress > Activities > Stunts (press R3 on a category), or by name at Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots, where found stunts are purple and completed ones white.
Keep going after the trophy if you are chasing the platinum: the 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, 50 more than this trophy.

tips: Under the Bridges are the quickest stunts to bank, per the roadmap.
The Under the Bridges, Knife Flights and Base Jumps location guides were still 'coming soon' in our sources — rely on the in-game Stunt Spots list.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: the tracker counts nine types of activity and wants each one tried at least once. Most are introduced by the story itself; the rest are one map filter away.

steps.t: Try each of the nine tracked types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Playing a Video Game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or drone race), and performing a stunt.
Check what is still missing at Touchpad > Progress > Activities — every type shows its own count when you scroll over it.
Filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find a nearby spot for any type you have not touched.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: First, a correction that matters: despite some guide titles saying '12 locations', this is 12 challenges at just 2 ranges — Griffin in the north-west of Vice City and Rodgers Ranch in the north-east of Port Gellhorn. Gold in all 12 challenges means 42 gold medals, and the 100% checklist demands exactly the same 42, so none of the work is wasted.

steps.t: Buy the Waiver Pass for $5 from the clerk at a range to unlock and mark its challenges. If you lack the required weapon type, renting one costs $10 — rented weapons are enough for every gold.
Griffin Shooting Range: 6 courses (3-Point, Hook, Loop, Maze, Compound, Villa) × 3 difficulties = 18 gold medals. These are movement courses, and Lucia runs and maneuvers better than Jason here.

Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range: 6 courses (Market, Zombie, Hunting, Saloon, Cops & Robbers, Alien) × 4 difficulties = 24 gold medals. These are stationary score-attacks — build your multiplier with body shots before spending it on headshots, because a miss lowers it.
Gold all 42 medals; the same 42/42 is required by the 100% checklist.

tips: Every challenge you finish — or even quit — permanently raises your Focus stat, which feeds the Gunslinger trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are three races per location (42 in total), but the trophy only needs a win at each location — the deeper checklist requirement is spelled out in the steps so you can bank it on the same visits.

steps.t: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.

While you are there, beat the par time on the first two races at each location: that unlocks the third race, and the 100% checklist counts 42/42 drone time trials — the third race only needs finishing, not winning.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique races in the game — you can ignore the half of the calendar that frustrates you. If the platinum is the goal, stay in the seat a little longer: the checklist wants 30 of the 40.

steps.t: Win any 20 different races; 40 unique races exist, so pick the ones that suit your driving.
For the 100% checklist, keep going to 30 of 40 unique races won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at his own game. After you meet him in Chapter 1, Cal sets up a fishing challenge and marks the spot himself — this can be banked inside Chapter 1, long before any clean-up stage.

steps.t: Meet Cal in Chapter 1's Feng Shui; afterwards he texts you and marks a fishing location (purple icon) west of Key Lento.
Go to the marked spot and beat Cal in his fishing challenge.

tips: Fishing also feeds your Focus — every landed fish adds roughly 10%.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game properly: all of its levels, once. Its extra challenges are not needed, and for the 100% checklist you do not even need to finish a game — just play all four. Note the timing quirk in the steps: the television at home goes dark for one whole chapter.

steps.t: Pick one of the four video games and complete all of its levels once; its challenges are not required.
Three games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, available from Chapter 1; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade machines out in the world.
The home TV is inaccessible during Chapter 2 and returns from Chapter 3. For the 100% checklist, merely playing all four games counts — you may quit immediately via the Touchpad.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is a five-quest, Lucia-only storyline that starts by itself in Chapter 3 and ends with Puff Puff Pass. It carries its own trophy and does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — and like every strand finale, it stays available after the story.

steps.t: In Chapter 3, Andy's call marks the strand and texts you a home address in Belville; the whole line is Lucia-only.
Play the five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass.
Finish Puff Puff Pass, Andy's final mission; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand sends you diving on seven shipwrecks. The one thing players get wrong here is panic: Kenton disappears after Chapter 1 and looks lost, but every source is clear that he comes back — temporarily unavailable is not missable.

steps.t: Meet Kenton during Chapter 1's Island Dreams; afterwards he is marked 'KR' in Key Lento and his strand of dive sites opens.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks. Track them at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
If Kenton vanishes after Chapter 1, keep playing: he returns in Chapters 2–3 and texts Jason. Calling Brian as Jason later in Chapter 2 can speed his return up.

tips: All seven wrecks are still required and still available when he returns — nothing about this strand can be lost.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five-quest strand at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, ending with Hometown Heroes. It has its own trophy, does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, and remains available after the story ends.

steps.t: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Billy's strand marks itself at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Play the five quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
Finish Hometown Heroes, Billy's final mission; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger strands — but not every strand counts, and the honest picture is that the counting list was still incomplete in our sources. Four counters are confirmed; several well-known strands definitely do not count because they carry their own trophies. The Yago strand DOES count, which is why its one time-sensitive quest gets a dispute panel below.

steps.t: Complete any 8 counting strands. Confirmed counters: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — and the roadmap notes there are more strangers yet to be discovered, so the list is not closed.
Do not grind these for this trophy: Kenton, Billy, Andy, Randy and Tyrone carry their own trophies, and Moses, Yasmani, Eddie, Shirley and Cal do not count either.
Check the trophy's own tracker after each finished strand to watch the count move.

Strand sequels arrive after delays — sometimes weeks of in-game time, sometimes only in a later chapter (Kirk starts in Chapter 1 but can only finish in Chapter 2). If nothing appears, do other missions or sleep.

disputes.topic: Can a missed race cost you this trophy?
disputes.a: The walkthrough marks Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) as time-sensitive and missable, the Yago strand counts toward this trophy, and two guides warn that missing the race could cost the trophy. Their advice: do it the moment it appears.
disputes.b: The Games Wiki lists the same race as time-limited but states flatly that it is 'not needed for trophies or 100%', and says its exact cut-off has not been established.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List is a 16-car shopping list of sports cars to steal and deliver. One of the sixteen is handed to you by the story itself; the other fifteen are yours to hunt, and clean deliveries are worth serious money.

steps.t: Play Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — it unlocks the Key Cloner and marks Randy, 'RK', in west Vice City.

Deliver the 16 sports cars on the Wish List. The Zorrusso is delivered automatically inside the story mission; the other 15 — Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D — are yours to steal.
Track the list at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; the target cars gather around the Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels.
Deliver each car undamaged — clean deliveries pay around $35,000 or more apiece.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only: shut down his Synthetic Labs across Vice City, then take the finale he issues afterwards. It has its own trophy, does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, and waits for you after the story.

steps.t: After Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, Tyrone's strand marks itself with purple Synthetic Lab markers in Vice City.
Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter — this line is Jason-only.
Tyrone then issues his final mission, Spin On This; finish it for the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The one genuine at-risk trophy in the game — and even this is unconfirmed. The first meditation, on the balcony of Jason's house in Chapter 1, adds +1 to the counter but is never marked as a Meditation Spot, and it disappears forever after Chapter 1. The full count is 18 = 1 (house) + 8 spots × 2 characters (16) + 1 (the final Ascent Mountain meditation). If the trophy truly needs 18/18 and the final meditation counts only +1, skipping the balcony caps you at 17/18. No source has confirmed the requirement either way — so do the balcony meditation, and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditations across ten locations, with a counting trick: from Chapter 2's Coffee Break the pair can travel together, and meditating with BOTH characters at one spot counts +2. That arithmetic is exactly why the unmarked Chapter 1 balcony meditation in the banner above might matter — read it before you leave Chapter 1.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, look at her and choose 'Accept'. This meditation adds +1 to the counter but is NOT marked as a spot, and it is gone after Chapter 1.

Meditate at the eight open-world spots with both Jason and Lucia for +2 each (16 total): Smooth Sand (Mariana County), Swamp, Worn Stone and Red Rocks (Kelly County), Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff and Waterfall (Lummox County), and Seaside (Leonard County).
The tenth location, Ascent Mountain on the peak of Mount Kalaga, only appears on the map after all other meditations are done; its final meditation counts +1 — 1 + 16 + 1 = 18.
Track the counter at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, or filter the map by 'Meditate Around Leonida'; spots show a purple icon when you are near.

tips: The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18 meditations, so A Long Road is safe whatever the answer turns out to be.
Worst case, a replay only needs to reach Chapter 2 — the final meditation requires both characters.
trophies.unconfirmed: Whether this trophy strictly requires the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is unconfirmed in every source we read — the roadmap's author had done it when the trophy popped, and nobody has yet proven the counter can reach 18 without it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting strand, Jason-only, built around his Target Decks. One correction to our own first edition: we previously flagged this as missable from its description alone — no source supports that. Bret's strand stays open after the story, and all 15 of his target decks are also required in full by the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Sometime after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason (Lucia cannot receive it) and the first quest, Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, marks itself. The strand is Jason-only.
Take Bret's unique rifle, the Killtelligence SM-69, from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. One clean shot keeps the animal in pristine condition and pays more — though it is not mandatory.
Work through Bret's Target Decks and hunt the unique animal he sends you after. Track the decks at Map > Activities > Target Deck and Progress > Contacts > Bret Vogel.

trophies.unconfirmed: Which specific unique animal triggers this trophy was 'still undergoing confirmation' in the roadmap — the strand, its availability and its 15 decks are all confirmed; only the exact trigger animal was open.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three Collectible Card sets. The full picture is bigger — 18 sets and 480 unique cards, in sets of 18 to 36 — and the 100% checklist eventually wants 15 of the 18 sets, so early collecting is never wasted. One scare is already settled: the two cards inside the Starlet Motel, which closes after Chapter 2, both exist in second copies elsewhere, so no set can ever be blocked.

steps.t: Collect cards toward any 3 complete sets; sets run from 18 to 36 cards, and some cards exist in duplicate locations.
Track every set at Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
If you are on the platinum road, keep going after the trophy: the checklist requires 15 of 18 sets.

tips: The motel's 'Vicki' and 'Victor Maravilla' cards have duplicates elsewhere — losing access to the motel cannot block a set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 sights with the WAiNK app. More than 100 scan sites exist across four categories, so you can skip the awkward ones and still finish comfortably.

steps.t: On foot near a scannable sight, wait for the popup, then hold Up + R1 to scan it.
Work the four categories: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — more than 100 sites in total.
Track progress at Progress > Collections > Waink Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges — eight categories of ten, every one of them available from the very start of the game. The checklist later raises the bar to 70, which still leaves you room to skip the ten hardest challenges in the game entirely.

steps.t: Complete any 50 challenges across the 8 categories; all 80 are available from game start.
Track them at Progress > Challenges — finished challenges carry a 'Completed' checkmark.
For the 100% checklist, push on to 70 of 80; the 10 hardest can always be left undone.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you. The detail that fails most attempts: escaping the flashing search area is not enough — the trophy only pops once you are fully out of the red heat zone.

steps.t: Wait until Chapter 2's Coffee Break unlocks free-roaming together; call your partner with Right + Triangle.
Reach a 4-star Wanted Level together, then escape — and keep going until you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the recommended hiding spot.

tips: Bank vault robberies hand you 4 stars automatically — escaping one with your partner during Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… earns this on the way.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops, back to back, with your partner, without ever losing the Wanted Level. The chain is fragile in a specific way: the level must stay flashing — if it drops into the red heat zone, the run is broken. And the pop is delayed, so do not restart too early.

steps.t: After Coffee Break, rob the first shop with your partner and keep the Wanted Level flashing; dropping into the red heat zone breaks the chain.
Rob two more shops back-to-back without losing the level. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — if it does not, rob a fourth.
A tidy route is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot the items in each store and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

tips: Leaving a store before the police arrive can leave the level too weak — if the chain feels dead, a fourth shop usually saves it.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — and 'discover' means scan, not drive. The WAiNK app registers a vehicle from a look, boats and aircraft included, out of 557 vehicles in the game at launch. Keep scanning past the trophy: the checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models.

steps.t: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then hold R1. Scanning is enough — you never need to drive them.
Everything counts: cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. There are 557 vehicles at launch, so traffic alone gets you most of the way.
Track discoveries at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
Keep going past 100 — the 100% checklist requires 200 of the 277 base models scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside a single Combat Focus use. The fight is mostly won before it starts: Focus is a resource you build up permanently through other activities, and this trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — you need gang enemies.

steps.t: Learn the resource: Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) drains the purple Focus bar at the top-left, under health and stamina. Food, drinks and washing your face or showering at home top it up.

Raise your Focus level (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus) through shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, caught fish and headshots — finishing or even quitting a range challenge raises it permanently.
Find a group of gang enemies — the guards at an illegal operation are ideal — and take down 5 inside one Focus use. Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) stretches the window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is DOCKED at a VCIA departure terminal and take off in it. Two clarifications from the sources: planes parked out on the airfield do not count, and the unlock is delayed until you are well clear of the airport. It is a repeatable free-roam action — our first edition's 'missable' tag on this one was wrong, and no source supports it.

steps.t: Go to VCIA and choose a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — terminals E3 and E4 are the easiest. Airfield-parked planes do not count.
Enter by the stairs at the boarding bridge, or walk in through the terminal; climb to the cockpit, reverse out to the airstrip and take off.
Keep flying: the trophy unlocks only about 1 km (0.6 mi) from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from the military base at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map. Get in, make some noise, and the trophy follows.

steps.t: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County, at the south-west edge of the map (placed on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys in one source).
Enter through the gate, or via the stunt jump by the south-east entrance; the tanks are parked in the south of the base.
Climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The whole attempt turns on one unlocked tool — the Snap Gun — and one habit: never kick a door. Everything else is a short checklist in a back room.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking and Jewelry Store Robberies (green icons in unfogged areas).
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun. Kicking the door trips the alarm and voids the undetected run.
In the back room, find the safe-code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage AND disable the alarm before leaving.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the recommended store; the trophy pops shortly after you walk out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults only open up through one specific Chapter 4 optional mission — the same mission that hands you your first vault — and every vault job instantly brings four stars. There are eight vaults in total, and the 100% checklist wants all eight.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail the security van, follow the guard with the briefcase in, and rob the temporarily-open vault — a partner is needed to hand off a bag (hold Right). This unlocks Large Bank Vaults.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time; every vault robbery instantly gives 4 stars.
There are 8 vaults in total and the 100% checklist requires all 8 — each can pay up to $205,000, and robbed vaults are marked on the map.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. For most players this one is free: the vault robbery inside Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… also counts as an armored-truck robbery. The manual method below is the back-up, and either way the pop waits until you are clear of the heat.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4's optional That's Where The Money Is… — its vault robbery doubles as an armored-truck robbery and usually pops this trophy on its own.
Manual method: block a roaming armored truck near a Vice City bank and sticky-bomb its back doors. Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
Escape afterwards — the trophy pops only once you are out of the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map of Leonida. There is no trick to it beyond coverage: the sources' one firm recommendation is to do it from the air, region by region, and to sweep the coastline and the Keys last, where the easy-to-miss grey patches hide.

steps.t: Take a plane and fly every part of Leonida — unfogging is far faster from the air than by road.
Sweep the edges last: the Keys, the south-west islands and the coastline are where the last grey patches usually hide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs — 39 operations exist, so you are sampling, not clearing. And nothing here can be lost: if you miss a key valuable, the operation respawns after a while and you can simply come back.

steps.t: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs; 39 operations exist in total, and the 100% checklist wants all 39.
Yellow icons appear when you come near an operation, and 19 of them are marked automatically as the story progresses.
Track the per-gang count at Progress > Gangs, shown at the bottom-right for each gang.
Missed a key valuable? Leave it — operations respawn after a long time, so the gang can be completed on a later visit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: One of the five hidden trophies whose trigger the sources do not agree on — we print the only concrete method we found, and label it honestly as unconfirmed below. The method itself is a small, repeatable bar visit on Ocean Beach, so there is no way to lock yourself out of trying it.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.unconfirmed: Only the PowerPyx roadmap gives this concrete method. OutputLag lists the trophy among five hidden trophies with 'no confirmed unlock method at launch', KeenGamer lists its trigger as 'still being confirmed', and another list we saw calls it unsolved. Treat the method as the best current lead, not settled fact.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A GTA III tribute with a very specific car: only the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom counts, and only once you own the Key Cloner. Like its four hidden companions, its method is single-sourced — flagged honestly below — and the action is repeatable in free-roam, so our first edition's 'missable' tag was wrong.

steps.t: Get the Key Cloner first — it unlocks during Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and steal the specific blue Banshee; no other car counts.
Drive it out through the showroom window. The unlock is slightly delayed — it pops after you have driven a little way down the street.

trophies.unconfirmed: The PowerPyx roadmap is the only opened source with this method. OutputLag lists the trophy among its five 'no confirmed trigger yet' entries and KeenGamer lists the method as 'still unconfirmed'.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a Kolt & Associates gang operation in Port Gellhorn that the story's optional Chapter 2 mission already takes you to. The valuables do not have to fall in one visit — the operation respawns, slowly, so this cannot be missed.

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — you first visit it in Chapter 2's optional Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Take valuable one and two: the luxury watch (golden icon, south-east office) and the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' (golden icon, on the table in the north-east corner).
Loot the safe in the north-east hallway office — the code is 0300, or use sticky bombs.
Escape the police afterwards; killing enemies is not required. Anything you missed can be collected on a later visit — the robbery icon respawns.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength on BOTH characters at the same time. The doubling trick is the whole guide: work out together and the partner who is 'inactive' trains automatically, so every session moves both bars.

steps.t: Wait for Chapter 2's Coffee Break — the pair can only train together from then on.
Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and work out together; the inactive partner auto-trains, doubling your progress.
Use fitness clubs (Map > Activities), or work out at home after the story, until both bars are full at once.
Check both characters at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, the heart icon.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Five hundred actions that move your Criminal Profile, gathered passively as you play — robberies, escapes and encounters all feed it from the first chapter. One warning travels with it: the deepest profile tier, Irredeemable, is permanent once reached. No trophy depends on your tier, so there is never a reason to chase it.

steps.t: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile, so every counted action shows the demon-face popup and you can watch the counter work.
Play naturally — the count accrues through robberies and encounters from the very start. Your progress is visible by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.

Know the tiers: Professional (stealth, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened, Violent, Psycho — and Irredeemable, which is PERMANENT per character and makes police shoot on sight. Profiles are tracked separately for Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: rob, as Lucia, the very same Payday Loans store she robbed in the Prologue — and this time escape on foot. The method is single-sourced and flagged below; every condition in it (alone, as Lucia, on foot) is load-bearing.

steps.t: Wait until Chapter 3's Credit Check unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer.
Go alone, as Lucia, to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Vice City's Little Cuba.
Aim at the teller, kill the security, break through the door and loot all 3 cash drawers.
Escape ON FOOT — a vehicle escape does not count. The unlock is delayed until you have left the police search area.

trophies.unconfirmed: The PowerPyx roadmap is the only opened source with this concrete method. OutputLag lists the trophy among its five 'no confirmed trigger yet' entries and KeenGamer lists it as 'unconfirmed'.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The UFO easter egg — and the least settled trophy on the entire list. One source documents a complete encounter; another offers two completely different leads and calls the trophy unconfirmed. We print the documented method as steps and put the rival leads in the dispute panel, because pretending this is settled would be a disservice.

steps.t: Be solo, at night after 2 AM, on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Watch for a blinking car waiting at the roadside — the spawn is random; if it is not there, drive away and come back.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO's bright blue light and approach it; it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.

disputes.topic: Three incompatible leads for one trophy
disputes.a: PowerPyx documents the full UFO encounter above: the Kelly County roadside car after 2 AM, the path into the woods, and walking the abducted woman back to her car.
disputes.b: OutputLag lists the trophy as unconfirmed and offers two different leads instead: a Crosstown stairwell room that can fill with glowing graffiti hiding a six-digit safe code, and a Chapter 2 UFO abduction story tied to a keypad code for the Abandoned Site north-east of Cottonmouth Lake — a code many players report failing.

trophies.unconfirmed: No method for this trophy is confirmed by more than one source. Try the documented encounter first; keep the rival leads in mind if it does not land.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A bike, a crowd and one minute: kick ten pedestrians from a moving bike inside 60 seconds. The method below is the only concrete one we found, and its precision is still being confirmed elsewhere — flagged honestly, as with the other hidden five.

steps.t: Get on any bike and head somewhere crowded — Vice City or Ocean Beach give you the densest pavements.
Kick pedestrians with Square as you ride: 10 kicks inside 60 seconds.

trophies.unconfirmed: Only the PowerPyx roadmap gives this precise method. OutputLag lists the trophy among its five 'no confirmed trigger yet' entries, and KeenGamer lists the precise method as 'still being confirmed'.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills — it does not have to move in one delivery. The pipeline unlocks in Chapter 3, the best-paying fence is named in the sources, and the fastest source of marked bills (bank vaults) arrives a chapter later.

steps.t: Unlock the marked-bills trade at Chapter 3's Credit Check, which also hands you the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores, then deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The total is cumulative across deliveries. Bank vaults are the richest source (up to $205,000 each), but they only unlock after Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is…

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. There is no wrong way to do it, but the sources are clear about the fast lanes: guns, car mods and tattoos burn money quickest, and Leonida is not short of tills.

steps.t: Spend across any shops you like — the $100,000 total is cumulative, and guns, car modifications and tattoos are the fastest sinks.
The high street is deep: 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 14 mod shops, 18 hair & beauty salons, 17 footwear stores, 15 electronics stores and 11 tattoo studios.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages for $160,000 in total. Four more garages arrive through the story and are not needed. The buying itself only unlocks partway through Chapter 2, when the phone installs the real-estate app.

steps.t: Play until Chapter 2's Daily Driver — garages then become purchasable through the 'Vice City Real Estate' app the phone installs with a notification.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages; the set costs $160,000 in total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Registration needs two things the related trophies provide — Moses' garage and parking spots from your garages — and it charges per car, so register cheap metal.

steps.t: After Chapter 2's Moses strand installs the Scooter Bros app, drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray', then 'Register', in his garage.
Registration requires garage parking spots (see Little Boxes) and costs money per vehicle — register cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
At first only tracker-free vehicles can register; from Chapter 3, Standard-Tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
